The assertion expects all nine cells of the 3×3 block, including the center `(3, 4)`. That rules out the "8 neighbors excluding center" and "4 orthogonal neighbors" options in the team note, so I kept the earlier implementation. It produces the asserted output in the same order.

```python
def get_coordinates(coord):
    x, y = coord
    return [[i, j] for i in range(x - 1, x + 2) for j in range(y - 1, y + 2)]
```

CONFIDENCE: 97
